intro.title: Last Time...
intro.sub:
Kimi played ALL day at the playground.
But uh-oh... running too fast can lead to... a tumble!

scenes.title: Oops, Down Goes Kimi
scenes.caption:
Trip! Tumble! THUD!
Kimi's knee meets a sneaky little rock.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mom, I fell down! I tripped over a rock. 😢

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Are you okay? Did you get hurt?

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: It hurts whenever I move.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Your knee is bleeding. You got a hole in your pants!

scenes.title: The Band-Aid Hero
scenes.caption:
Clean it, dab it, cover it —
the magic band-aid to the rescue!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I'm scared because I'm bleeding. 😨

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: It's fine. It's going to stop soon. We need to clean the wound.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Ouch! The sterilizer hurts!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's cover the wound with a band-aid. It keeps the germs out. 🩹

scenes.title: The Itchy Bug Bite
scenes.caption:
A mosquito had a snack on Kimi's arm.
It's SO itchy... but do NOT scratch!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mom, I think I got a bug bite here. It's swollen and red.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Don't scratch it. If you scratch it, germs will get in.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: But I can't stand it! 😖

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Put this ice pack on it. It will get better if you don't scratch it.

scenes.title: The Sniffles
scenes.caption:
Achoo! The next morning,
Kimi wakes up with a drippy nose...

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mom, I caught a cold. I have a runny nose and a sore throat. 🤧

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let me feel your forehead. Oh — you have a fever.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I feel dizzy and weak. I want to lie down all day.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Your body is fighting the germs right now. I'll cool you down with a wet towel.

scenes.title: Brave at the Doctor's
scenes.caption:
White coats, a stethoscope...
and the question Kimi is scared to ask.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's go see the doctor. It's just a regular checkup.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Do I have to get a shot? 😨

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: It will sting a little. Don't be scared. Take a deep breath.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Wow, you're doing well by not crying!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I did it! I didn't cry! 💪

scenes.title: Medicine & the Tooth Fairy
scenes.caption:
Yucky medicine, then sweet candy...
and wait — something is WIGGLING in Kimi's mouth!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's take some medicine. This is for your cough, and this is for your runny nose.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: It's very bitter! 😖

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Drink all of it. Here's some water and candy after.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mom! I've got a loose tooth! It's wiggling! 🦷

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Place it under your pillow. The tooth fairy will come while you sleep. ✨

ending.title: Get Well Soon, Kimi!
ending.sub: To be continued... Next episode: Good Night, Kimi! 🌙
